title: PWM & Motor Physics
summary: Harness high-power inductors! Control motor speed with pulse width modulation and protect pins with flyback diodes.

steps.title: Inductive Coils & Magnetic Fields
steps.markdownContent: Motors and relays contain coils of copper wire that generate magnetic fields to produce mechanical torque. But motors are inductive loads: an ATmega328P output pin can only supply 20mA, while a stalled DC motor draws **500mA to 2000mA**! Attempting to power a motor directly from an Arduino pin will destroy its internal driver transistors.

steps.title: The Flyback Diode Protector
steps.markdownContent:
According to Lenz's Law ($V = -L \frac{di}{dt}$), when current flowing through a motor coil is abruptly cut, the collapsing magnetic field generates a massive reverse voltage spike called **inductive kickback** (>60 Volts!).

A reverse-biased **Flyback Diode** placed across the coil safely recirculates this spike, dissipating the inductive energy harmlessly as heat instead of frying your microcontroller.

steps.title: H-Bridge IC Pinout & Common Ground
steps.markdownContent:
Inspect the L293D Dual H-Bridge IC (`comp_l293d`):
1. Locate the semi-circular notch on top of the DIP-16 chip. Pin 1 is to the left of the notch.
2. **Pin 16 ($V_{CC1}$)**: Logic 5V (from Arduino 5V).
3. **Pin 8 ($V_{CC2}$)**: Motor Power (connect to separate external 6V–9V battery pack).
4. **Pins 4, 5, 12, 13**: Connect to common Ground.
5. **CRITICAL**: Always connect the external motor battery Ground to the Arduino Ground to establish a shared 0V reference!

steps.title: L293D Bidirectional Motor Control
Flyback Checkpoint
steps.markdownContent: Why do engineers install a flyback diode across DC motor and relay coils?

interactiveConfig.question: What is the purpose of a flyback diode?
options: To absorb high-voltage inductive kickback spikes when the coil shuts off
To make the motor spin backwards
To turn battery power into AC wall electricity

questions.question: What causes inductive kickback spikes when a motor is suddenly turned off?
options: The collapsing magnetic field in the motor's copper coils induces a high reverse voltage
The battery releases excess chemical energy
Static electricity on the motor casing

questions.question: What is the primary function of a flyback diode connected across an inductive load?
options: To safely clamp and dissipate high-voltage inductive kickback spikes
To make the motor spin twice as fast
To convert AC voltage to DC voltage

questions.question: Why can you NOT power a standard DC hobby motor directly from an Arduino digital pin?
options: Arduino pins provide only ~20mA, while motors require 300mA–1000mA+ and can destroy pin transistors
Arduino digital pins output AC voltage
The code would be too complex

questions.question: What circuit architecture allows a microcontroller to reverse a motor's rotation direction?
options: An H-Bridge circuit
A voltage divider
A low-pass filter

questions.question: What electrical problem occurs if you fail to connect the motor battery ground to Arduino ground?
options: No shared reference voltage: control signals float and the motor driver cannot interpret logic states
The battery explodes
The Arduino executes code at half speed

questions.question: Why does an Arduino often crash or reset if a motor is wired directly to its 5V pin?
options: Brownout reset: the sudden motor inrush current pulls the 5V rail voltage below the microcontroller operating limit
Software stack overflow
Flash memory corruption

questions.question: In an H-bridge driver, what happens if both high-side and low-side switches on the same leg turn on simultaneously?
options: Shoot-through short circuit that burns out the transistors
The motor doubles its torque
The motor switches to generator mode

questions.question: Why does a DC motor hum but refuse to turn at very low PWM values (e.g. 15 out of 255)?
options: Static mechanical friction (stiction) requires a minimum threshold torque to overcome
The PWM frequency is too high for electricity to flow
The Arduino compiler ignores values below 20
